title: A Machine for the Horizon
author: Zephyrine Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Dravenmoor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
